evaluation.definition: Percentage of questions for which at least one manually labelled relevant evidence page appears in the top five retrieved results.
evaluation.relevance_labels: Manually selected primary evidence pages, corrected after source inspection.

successful_fixes.failure: AI system operating beyond its knowledge limits

limitations: Relevance labels were manually selected and may not capture every relevant passage.
Hit Rate@5 checks for at least one relevant page in the top five; it does not measure the proportion of all relevant pages retrieved.
The MANAGE-function failure was observed with 600-word chunks; the 300-word evaluation had no misses.
Query expansion was tested on the identified failure queries.
